# Facebook Photos Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-photos-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-photos-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.351**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract data from one or multiple Facebook images. Get image ID, Facebook photo URL, image URL, OCR text, and more. Download the data in JSON, CSV, and Excel and use it in apps, spreadsheets, and reports.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Photo $0.003, Actor start $0.001 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-photos-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-photos-scraper@0.0.351#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Facebook URLs — Valid facebook URL |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | Maximum number of results — If this limit is not set as many results as possible are returned |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `facebookUrl` | string \| null | URL of the Facebook profile or page the photos were scraped from. |
| `inputUrl` | string \| null | Input URL used to scrape the photos. |
| `facebookId` | string \| null | Facebook ID of the source profile or page. |
| `id` | string \| null | Facebook photo ID. |
| `dataType` | string \| null | Type of the media item (e.g. photo, video). |
| `image` | string \| null | URL of the photo image. |
| `ocrText` | string \| null | Text extracted from the photo via OCR (accessibility caption). |
| `url` | string \| null | URL of the Facebook photo page. |
| `width` | number \| null | Width of the photo in pixels. |
| `height` | number \| null | Height of the photo in pixels. |
| `is_playable` | boolean \| null | Whether the media item is a playable video. |
| `creation_story` | object \| null | Creation story associated with the photo. |
| `groupTitle` | string \| null | Title of the group the photo belongs to (for group photos). |
| `__isNode` | string \| null | GraphQL interface indicator for node type. |
| `pageAdLibrary` | object \| null | Ad Library information for the source page. |
| `navSections` | array \| null | Navigation sections available on the source page. |
| `validatedUrls` | array \| null | List of validated URLs associated with the photo. |
| `error` | string \| null | Error message if scraping this URL failed. |
| `errorDescription` | string \| null | Detailed error description if scraping this URL failed. |
